note: Ready-made salary rule sets. Ratios are multiples of the salary cap (or of the cap for min/max/mid-level salary), so the same preset works at any cap size.

soft_cap_with_hard_limit.label: Soft cap with hard limit (recommended)
soft_cap_with_hard_limit.description: Free agents can only be signed with cap space, but teams may go over the cap by re-signing their own players, using one mid-level exception, and signing minimum contracts. Payroll above the tax line is taxed, and no team can ever exceed the hard limit.

hard_cap.label: Hard cap
hard_cap.description: No team may ever exceed the cap, and there are no exceptions. Rosters must be built within the limit; keeps spending equal but forces stars to leave.

no_cap.label: No cap (luxury tax only)
no_cap.description: Teams may spend anything; payroll above the tax line is taxed. Rich markets will dominate unless the tax is steep.
